snippet.title: Everbark - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Unearth the secrets of the Everbark in this psx style first-person horror game. Don the boots of park ranger Craig, a first-responder tasked with investigating a distress call sent from deep within the Dandenong rainforest.

Game made by Jazari
Twitter: https://twitter.com/jazzbduncan
Itch.io Page: https://jazari.itch.io/everbark
